reviews.text: Really good service. Warm and nice reception. They took the cat's problems seriously and investigated them carefully.

The service was rude and inconsiderate. The customer's time was of no importance. The vet was 40 minutes late just because he was writing up previous patient reports. He blamed the system for this.. patients first - reports later. Or calling the patient to say they are late, do you want another appointment. Saying the vet is a little late cannot mean 40 minutes. A little is 5 minutes! I will not come again.
Good service, parking space available, got the cat ultrasound

I was at a routine vaccination appointment. Since my cat has had a previous reaction to a vaccine, the vaccine will need to be administered somewhere other than the neck, such as the leg or tail. The vet decided to administer the vaccine to the leg. But even this fairly simple procedure was not successful: he didn’t hit the cat’s leg right away, but instead missed it completely and started injecting the vaccine. Half of the vaccine spilled out onto the treatment table. Honestly, I’ve never seen anything like this before.
You won’t find a better veterinary clinic in Finland, I’m sure of it.

A loyal customer of the place since its founding, where it has always been warmly welcomed and understood, experienced a big blow today. My previous dog was the kindest and easiest to handle, the current one was traumatized early in its life and therefore a slightly more challenging case, although very friendly and has always let me take care of it. My dog ​​has received good and understanding care up until now and has always been happy to go to Livet.
Today was a complete blow, the other people there also heard about it, because the conversation took place in the reception area. So, based on today's visit, Livet welcomes completely kind animals. Yes, I felt humiliated and sad about the actions and encounter of the employee (not a veterinarian)😢
One of the most friendliest, caring and professional vets in Helsinki. Price, service and care has always been of high quality and has us going back when help is needed.
Great service and professional operation.

As a small business owner, I understand the price level, unfortunately in Finland it is expensive to operate sensibly and with quality at the moment. I'm not saying that prices couldn't be cheaper, they certainly could, but would the quality of work improve? I doubt it.
We have tried cheaper places and we are happy to pay for quality, which seems to be completely forgotten in Finland these days, price is the most important argument in everything, no matter what the field.

When you commit to an animal, by taking it into your life, you also commit to paying for the treatments, although admittedly sometimes the size of the bill is surprising.

Today we had to give up our family member, whose dental work we are still paying for. Our dog received good care at Livet and at the place they recommended for neurological problems.

The euthanasia was handled at Livet from start to finish on the dog's terms, not forgetting the owners' shock, thank you Livet people!

If a furry friend comes to our house again, I know where he will get good service.

Very professional and warm personal, we got everything we needed very quickly, no queue or waiting. It is second time we are visiting this clinic, previously we visited cardiologist and she also was very nice and professional, she checked heart of our dog very thoroughly and we were very happy with the service we got.

We had only had good experiences with the place in the past. However, the previous visit was the last. We took the cat for dental treatment, and the next day the cat's condition deteriorated. We called the clinic and asked them to bring the cat in for a check-up. The doctor did not find anything unusual in the cat. I had noticed right away that the cat was scratching one of its eyes. I told the doctor about this, who had only noticed the same thing after I had pointed it out. The doctor who performed the dental treatment and examination was clearly new and still unskilled, and the nurse also had to constantly advise him. The doctor would have taken more expensive tests if I had not been awake in the situation! It was a corneal ulcer and the end result was two eye drops and a collar around the neck for two weeks - during this whole time I had to be at home with the cat and away from work, because eating and going to the bathroom were not possible with the collar. The worst part was that they did not reimburse the visit in question, even though the ulcer had clearly occurred during the previous day's dental treatment. No apologies, nothing. However, after some persuasion, they agreed to reimburse the inspection visit. The experience left me with the impression that, unfortunately, money comes before the animal's health here too.

In the almost nine years I've had dogs, I feel like I've found a nice veterinary clinic.

The staff at the reception desk are very helpful and empathetic. The same goes for the doctor and nurse. I somehow got the feeling that they're trying to listen and help as best they can.

It's so important to me how you meet a customer, how you approach the situation, and how you plan treatment individually, not just for the sake of money.

Our 6-year-old corgi Luan received such good care and attention, even though it was an impossible situation despite anesthesia. 🥲 It's been about three weeks since her visit and she's recovered well (with the help of medication).

Thanks to the people who took care of Luan. 🤍

Another plus is the free parking and good location. Luan's pee damage was also cleaned up in the lobby, even though I offered to clean it up myself. Thank you. 🤍

I was a satisfied customer for years, now I think with the new expensive location, money comes before customer satisfaction here too.

The dog had a surprising complication during sterilization (the spleen was cut while opening the stomach) and there was also a strange wound next to the surgical wound when we picked him up home that was not explained in any way. We spent the weekend worrying about whether he would start bleeding internally and whether he would have to go to the emergency room, fortunately we managed with a scare. When we asked for compensation for this, Livet's response was that they do not compensate for stress or upset and that it was a normal complication. However, the veterinarian who performed the surgery commented that this had never happened to him before.

It left us wondering whether we are valued as customers at all and whether the animal receives the best possible care here at an expensive price.

Fortunately, you can vote with your feet, which means that in the future we will take the family's animals elsewhere for treatment.

A very positive visit experience. The doctor and nurses were professional and even though my big dog didn't really cooperate with the blood tests, we managed to get through it with a calm attitude.
The doctor explained everything very clearly and in a way that was understandable. Fortunately, the big concern was solved with an easy and cheap solution and now everything is fine again!

It was easy to get an appointment, and it's easy to get to the place. The dog, who was very excited about the event, received an understanding welcome and the doctor was absolutely wonderful. We also got good help with the problem, it started working right away that same evening.

I got an appointment within an hour of calling and the tick removal from the dog's troublesome area went smoothly! Super friendly and professional staff, fast service and clean premises :) the building is currently under renovation but the instructions on site were well marked.

We had to use our dog for major surgery in the midst of our family's biggest crisis. The clinic's doctor Anu and the wonderful nurses did an excellent job for our dog, taking care of us wholeheartedly. Follow-up care was taken care of well by phone and email.
With years of customer experience, I can warmly recommend it.

Super high recommendations. Here they treat the patient like a king/queen. They focus on the patient and dig into the cause of the problem and treat it properly. Customer service is friendly and helpful. The doctors and lovely assistants are knowledgeable. Big Thank You
Great ultra
Really great place. The staff has been fantastic every time. The service is great, the customer is kept up to date. The new facilities were nice and functional, extra points for the huge parking lot.
Nice staff and good service. Sisu - the cat has received good care here. Free parking. The cat can wait for the doctor in the treatment room, which is nice, as the waiting room can be stressful.
Really nice service and expert care. The veterinarian is Taru, a really positive and knowledgeable doctor. We were able to watch the cat's ultrasound and the doctor explained everything clearly

A very knowledgeable and good cardiologist at Livet. However, the position itself had to be changed in other services, because Livet is a direct funding organization. Treatment is guided by the possibility of funding visits, not the dog's best interests and health.

Car maintenance type of activity. They collect invoices even though the outcome is immediately known. I do not recommend it in any challenging cases as an owner of several dogs. Vaccinations etc. will probably be successful.
Takes exemplary care of animals.
Really nice staff and service. The tartar removal from a 13 year old with a heart defect went better than I dared to hope.

Livet has become a chain, money is the most important thing. They have a call back service, but you have to wait until you get bored. Pets are treated well, owners are not really good at dealing with them.

Wonderful service right from the door! The vet was very professional and the nurses too. We finally got a diagnosis for our dog Elsa's long-standing symptoms. We are really satisfied and can definitely recommend 🐶🐾 …
We are so grateful to have found this very knowledgeable, efficient, friendly and empathetic veterinary clinic! Thank you so much for everything❤️

Meeting the dog without breed prejudices, good grip on the dog and its handling. We start to investigate skin problems thoroughly and not just by medication. Overall a good experience and clear home instructions.
